modules/Battlearena/scr/00001.money.scr: If this object has met the triggerer before, nothing happens. Otherwise, give the triggerer 2000 gold (a negative amount takes it away). Either way, stop the script (the game then reacts normally).
modules/Battlearena/scr/00002barter.scr: Start a conversation, opening with dialogue line 1, and then stop the script (the game then reacts normally).
modules/Battlearena/scr/00003exp.scr: If this object has met the triggerer before, nothing happens. Otherwise, give the triggerer the experience of a level 14 quest. Either way, stop the script (the game then reacts normally).
modules/Battlearena/scr/00009.scr: This object says, in floating text: dialogue line 1, and then stop the script (the game then reacts normally).
modules/Battlearena/scr/00999Credits.scr: Add slide 1 to the ending of the game, and then stop the script (the game then reacts normally).
modules/Battlearena/scr/00004.scr: The triggerer says, in floating text: dialogue line 1, and then stop the script (the game then reacts normally).
